rationale: Revised 2026-09-14 contract fully implemented and all review findings closed. Catalog templates expose required_variables on GET /workflows/prebuilt and GET /workflows/prebuilt/{slug}; POST /workflows/prebuilt/{slug}/materialize substitutes user values and returns a create-workflow seed. Persisted workflow create/update treats ${input:…} as plain text (no save-time rejection), so existing workflows with similar strings in prompts are not broken. CR-001 through CR-010 resolved in code and branch history; 2 pre-existing hardcoded-email items remain deferred in code-review-deferred.md.
